summary: This Form 6-K filed by NatWest Group plc reports routine PDMR share transactions under its employee share plan — vesting of deferred awards, tax withholdings, and share sales by executives — with no special-situation transaction or corporate event. It is a standard equity compensation disclosure that does not indicate a change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing simply satisfies ongoing reporting requirements for foreign private issuers.
